decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution serves government customers and connects to over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains a core, revenue-generating offer tied to regulatory demand.
The cyber security awareness module is low-cost to maintain, fits the certified training business and benefits from rising compliance requirements such as NIS2.
Behaviour analysis complements the firm's aviation security personnel and supports its integrated technology-plus-people strategy in an expanding market.
The passenger profiling method is embedded in long-standing airport and airline services and draws on the firm's core competence.
